dimensions.name: narrative_clarity
dimensions.evidence_note: Both reports explain the motivation and architecture coherently. Reader v3 adds a paper-specific progression and local visual blocks; Direct-AI is shorter and more immediately linear.

dimensions.name: scientific_completeness
dimensions.evidence_note: Reader v3 explicitly separates Tables 1-4, ablation sensitivity, parsing transfer, and qualitative appendix boundaries; Direct-AI covers these but with less local evidence detail.

dimensions.name: method_explanation
dimensions.evidence_note: Both explain scaled dot-product, multi-head attention, masking and positional encoding. Reader v3 binds the explanation to Figure 1 and Figure 2 and states the encoder/decoder asymmetry.

dimensions.name: experiment_result_understanding
dimensions.evidence_note: Reader v3 preserves base/big and En-De/En-Fr distinctions, FLOP caveats, ablations and parsing comparator limits; Direct-AI reports the main numbers accurately but more compactly.

dimensions.name: figure_table_correctness
dimensions.evidence_note: Direct-AI mentions the tables and visualizations but does not reconstruct their visual organization. Reader v3 binds all material figures/tables to verified page-localized assets and identifies the duplicate T02-p8 candidate as rejected.

dimensions.name: conclusion_calibration
dimensions.evidence_note: Both avoid claiming universal replacement. Reader v3 makes asymptotic, FLOP-estimate, parsing and qualitative-interpretability limits explicit in the conclusion path.

dimensions.name: boundary_coverage
dimensions.evidence_note: Reader v3 gives dedicated boundary prose for quadratic cost, selected comparisons, no repeated-seed uncertainty, and qualitative attention evidence.

dimensions.name: critical_insight
dimensions.evidence_note: Reader v3's strongest added insight is that the result is a configuration-and-protocol package, not attention alone; Direct-AI states the same idea but less forcefully.

dimensions.name: unsupported_prose
dimensions.evidence_note: Neither report contains a major unsupported scientific claim. Reader v3 has more prose and therefore more surface area, but its visible claims are source-bound.

dimensions.name: provenance_usefulness
dimensions.evidence_note: Reader v3 provides source SHA, page-localized visual bindings, task/envelope records and an Evidence Atlas. Direct-AI records source identity but has no page-level evidence graph.

dimensions.name: overall_understandability
dimensions.evidence_note: Both make the paper understandable. Reader v3 is more useful for source-assisted audit and visual inspection; Direct-AI has a lower cognitive overhead for a quick first read.

result.qualitative_notes: PRE_ANTITEMPLATE_SMOKE diagnostic only. Reader v3 adds concrete value in source/page provenance, figure/table localization, explicit asymptotic-versus-measured distinctions, and boundary analysis. It is worse where the generated Reader is longer, more visually dense, and inherits renderer/CJK typography and sparse-page defects. The pair is not a blinded human study and the continuation direct baseline is newly generated because the historical cloud baseline was unavailable.
release_blockers: Historical cloud Lead Reader and Direct-AI artifacts are unavailable; continuation outputs cannot be used as historical-run evidence.
Lens execution used parent-direct sequential role passes after the context-isolated worker harness failed; context isolation is not independently verified.
Kami reports Songti-SC CJK fallback and sparse pages 11-13; visual QA requires human review of every rendered page.
No human blind evaluation or repeated-seed quality study was performed.
